R1_04_delayed_fill_protection.mechanism: Strict algoId/orderId parsing; RESERVED -> PENDING_CONFIRMATION persisted before POST; exact authoritative query validates exchange/client ID, symbol, exit side, STOP_MARKET, BOTH, reduceOnly, trigger, quantity, NEW; ACTIVE owner and protective execution row commit atomically. R1_06_short_position_open.mechanism: Durable full environment/namespace/account/symbol/BOTH lifecycle records every flat/open/close observation and atomic outbox; short opens and direct reversals preserved.

R1_1_01_durable_position_case_recovery.mechanism: PositionSupervisor persists PositionEvent and outbox record in live_position_case_dispatches with explicit PENDING/DISPATCHING/DONE/FAILED_CLOSED lifecycle in single atomic transaction; atomic lease claiming with lease_expires_at_ms ensures safe restart recovery without requiring original observation replay; position_case_from_event derives deterministic CasePackageV1 identity strictly from immutable event.observed_at_ms; downstream LiveStore case reservation prevents repeated primary-provider LLM analysis across retries; DONE never dispatches twice

R1_1_02_protection_uses_current_open_pos.mechanism: One-way current position queried; unsupported hedge mode blocked. Only exact owned stops may be resized/canceled, and protection never exceeds actual open or approved filled quantity.

R1_1_03_signed_client_isolated_testnet_a.mechanism: BinanceSignedClient constructor defaults environment='UNBOUND' and credential_namespace='UNBOUND', which fails closed under ExecutionCapabilityPolicyV1; create_testnet_signed_client factory requires valid BINANCE_TESTNET_API_KEY and BINANCE_TESTNET_API_SECRET, never reads LIVE credentials, and fails startup closed on missing credentials

R1_2_01_frozen_position_case_outbox.mechanism: PositionSupervisor persists exact PositionCase authority (position_case_id, position_case_hash, position_case_json, case_hash) into live_position_case_dispatches before external side effects; retry reuses exact stored case without re-querying fresh_market_case; tampered hash/JSON or event-linkage mismatch fails closed; additive migration maintains backward compatibility

R2_01_proposal_intent_compilation_bindin.mechanism: Shared compile_executable_intent_fields derives canonical executable fields (symbol, side, order_type, price, quantity, leverage, stop_loss, take_profit_1, take_profit_2, risk_policy_hash, account authority) used by both TradeIntent builder and PreExecutionValidator; validator recomputes approved contract and rejects any divergence with EXECUTABLE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH

R2_02_testnet_side_effect_persisted_auth.mechanism: PreExecutionAuthorizationV1 receipt durable storage in live_pre_execution_authorizations; TestnetExecutionBackend rejects unpersisted/tampered intents and exposes submit_authorized and reconcile_authorized requiring valid authorization_id; verifies hashes, account authority, and TTL before exchange mutation; in-flight mutation shielded against task cancellation

R2_03_position_lease_ownership_verificat.mechanism: PositionSupervisor verifies lease ownership at each lifecycle transition: case freeze checks rowcount == 1, renews and verifies lease ownership immediately before calling external analysis, and verifies lease on DONE transition; stale workers abort with zero downstream analysis calls

R2_04_live_v1_operational_runtime.mechanism: LiveV1Runtime owns async lifecycles for market stream, TESTNET user data stream, periodic REST reconciliation loop, position outbox recovery drain, and position supervisor polling; integrated into FastAPI lifespan; requires explicit testnet_execution_enabled opt-in; rejects LIVE and AUTONOMOUS configurations; starts unreconciled and recovers state before accepting risk

R2_1_01_signed_client_capability_policy_.mechanism: removed production TEST and .test exceptions from _require_mutation_authority; all mutating signed requests strictly enforce ExecutionCapabilityPolicyV1 and TESTNET authority; unit tests use test-scoped patch
